category: vps (hosted, Los Angeles, KVM, IPv4 and IPv6)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. KVM 1GB is USD 17.99 a year (about USD 1.50 a month) on annual billing until 8 November 2026: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, 2TB/month of bandwidth, Los Angeles. The standing KVM ladder starts at USD 3.99 a month (KVM-512: 512 MB, 15 GB SSD, 1 TB premium bandwidth, 1 IPv4 and 1 IPv6 address).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a virtual server, not an object store

retention.stated: not applicable: a live server, not stored bytes

egress.terms: 2TB/month on KVM 1GB and 1 TB/month on KVM-512, on a premium port of 1-10Gbps; extra bandwidth is sold at USD 2.00 a month per 1 TB. No overage rate and no post-allowance policy is published on the pages read.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 2.00 per 1 TB per month (KVM upgrade add-on)

interface_detail: Root SSH on a full KVM guest; SolusVM or Virtualizor panel on the standing ladder, a VPS control panel and Docker Manager on the Diwali plans.
tooling: ssh, any VPN or tunnel daemon the guest kernel supports; the OpenVZ line states TUN/TAP/PPP.
chaining: A KVM guest with one IPv4 and one IPv6 address per plan is a UDP-capable endpoint in Los Angeles; the pages read state no NAT, no port-forward count and no inbound filter, and no routed IPv6 prefix (one IPv6 address is listed).
binding_note: 2TB/month is the only published ceiling on KVM 1GB; the first failure for a high-volume job is the allowance, after which extra bandwidth is a USD 2.00 a month add-on per 1 TB.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the client-area register page says an account is made by placing an order, and the order-form fields were not read; the pages list 'Multi Currency Payment Supported & Accepted' without naming a method.

reliability_note: The annual price is a promotion that ends on 8 November 2026; the renewal price is not stated on the pages read.
confidence_note: The price, the 2TB/month allowance and the IPv4 and IPv6 lines are vendor sentences read on 2026-11-03. Identity, the renewal price and whether the IPv6 line is one address or a prefix are not stated, so the record is not raised above documented for those fields.
